name: services/housing/allocation_period_index
description: Get the index of all allocation periods defined in this USOS installation.
brief_description: Get the index of all allocation periods.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of allocation_period method.

arguments.name: as_object
arguments.description: if true an object is returned instead of a list. The object will be of the same structure as the one returned by the dormroom_types method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A list of allocation_period objects, ordered by the start field.
